question.text: Saraswati Growth Fund is being set up as a Category II AIF with a proposed corpus of INR 400 crore. Compute the minimum continuing interest that the Sponsor/Manager must contribute into the scheme as per SEBI (AIF) Regulations, 2012.

answer.text: INR 5 crore (lower of 2.5% of corpus or INR 5 crore)

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI (AIF) Regulations mandate Sponsor/Manager continuing interest of the lower of 2.5% of corpus or INR 5 crore for Category I/II AIFs. Here, 2.5% of INR 400 crore = INR 10 crore; but the cap is INR 5 crore, so the lower figure INR 5 crore applies. Skin-in-the-game cannot be through waiver of management fees. The Trap: Option A picks the straight 2.5% figure, ignoring the INR 5 crore cap. Option C invokes a 1% figure that does not apply to Cat I/II. Option D is a fabricated floor. Candidates often miss the 'lower of' language and compute only the 2.5%. Note: Workbook pages 83-84 and 333 support the Cat I/II continuing-interest rule and the no-fee-waiver condition.
